species.name: Song Sparrow

photo_variants.label: Typical Adult

diagnostics.mark: Coarse heavy streaks merging into large central spot
Broad gray supercilium and dark brown mustache stripe
Long, rounded tail pumped continuously in flight

species.rule_out: Baseline Little Brown Job. Coarse messy streaks + central stickpin + pumped rounded tail = Song Sparrow.
species.photo_caption: Coarse streaking, central stickpin, long rounded pumped tail
species.crux_caption: Baseline Little Brown Job. Coarse messy streaks + central stickpin + pumped rounded tail = Song Sparrow.

diagnostics.mark: Bright yellow supraloral dot directly in front of eye
Crisp square snow-white throat bib against gray breast
Boldly striped head (either black/white or tan/brown)

species.rule_out: Yellow lores + crisp square white throat bib = White-throated Sparrow (both morphs).
species.photo_caption: Crisp black/white crown, bright yellow supraloral spot, stark white throat bib
species.crux_caption: Yellow lores + crisp square white throat bib = White-throated Sparrow (both morphs).

species.name: Swamp Sparrow

photo_variants.label: In Reeds
photo_variants.caption: Typical damp skulking posture showing unbarred rusty wings and gray collar

diagnostics.mark: Solid bright rich rufous wings without white wingbars
Clean slate-gray nape and breast band; white throat
Solid rufous cap (split by gray median line in immatures)

species.rule_out: Solid rusty unbarred wings + clean gray collar + damp wetland habitat = Swamp Sparrow.

species.crux_caption: Solid rusty unbarred wings + clean gray collar + damp wetland habitat = Swamp Sparrow.

Completely unstreaked plain grayish-buff underparts
Dusky eyeline behind eye; streaky brown-rufous crown in fall

species.rule_out: Tiny slim size + unstreaked breast + dark line trailing behind eye + notched tail = Chipping Sparrow.

species.crux_caption: Tiny slim size + unstreaked breast + dark line trailing behind eye + notched tail = Chipping Sparrow.

Bold white eye-ring on totally plain unstreaked buffy-gray face
Completely unstreaked, clean warm buffy wash

species.rule_out: Bright candy-pink bill + prominent white eye-ring on blank innocent face = Field Sparrow.
